REPORTS.TITLE: Reports
REPORTS.NO_PIPELINE: Create a pipeline to see the funnel metrics
REPORTS.CURRENCY_NOTE: Amounts are shown in {currency} and are plain sums of each deal value, with no currency conversion. The CSV export carries the currency of every deal.
REPORTS.CURRENCY_NOTE_MIXED: Amounts are shown without a currency symbol: they are plain sums of each deal value, with no currency conversion. The CSV export carries the currency of every deal.
REPORTS.MIXED_CURRENCIES: This account has pipelines in more than one currency ({currencies}). The totals below add up the deal values as they are, so they do not represent an amount in a single currency.

FUNNEL.TITLE: Conversion funnel
FUNNEL.DESCRIPTION: Deals that entered each stage and how many of them moved further down the pipeline.
FUNNEL.EMPTY: No deals went through this pipeline in the selected period

SOURCES.TITLE: Which channel brings money
SOURCES.DESCRIPTION: Wins and losses by the channel the deal came from, closed within the selected period.
SOURCES.EMPTY: No deals were closed in the selected period

FORECAST.TITLE: Forecast
FORECAST.DESCRIPTION: Open deals by expected close month, weighted by the probability of the stage they are in.
FORECAST.EMPTY: No open deals expected to close in the selected period
FORECAST.PAST_RANGE: The selected period has already ended, so it can only show deals whose expected close date is in the past. Pick a future period to forecast.

LOSS_REASONS.TITLE: Loss reasons
LOSS_REASONS.DESCRIPTION: Why deals were lost in the selected period, by count and value.
LOSS_REASONS.EMPTY: No deals were lost in the selected period

SALES_CYCLE.TITLE: Sales cycle
SALES_CYCLE.DESCRIPTION: Average time between creating a deal and closing it.
SALES_CYCLE.EMPTY: No deals were closed in the selected period

WON_CYCLE.LABEL: Time to win
WON_CYCLE.INFO: Average time between the creation of a deal and the moment it was won.

WON_DEALS.LABEL: Deals won
WON_DEALS.INFO: Number of deals the average time to win was calculated from.

LOST_CYCLE.LABEL: Time to lose
LOST_CYCLE.INFO: Average time between the creation of a deal and the moment it was lost.

LOST_DEALS.LABEL: Deals lost
LOST_DEALS.INFO: Number of deals the average time to lose was calculated from.

STAGE_DURATIONS.TITLE: Time per stage
STAGE_DURATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Average time a deal stays in each stage. Only completed stays are counted, so a card still sitting in a stage is not in the average.
STAGE_DURATIONS.EMPTY: No stage was completed in the selected period

BOARD.TITLE: Kanban Board
BOARD.ARCHIVED_HINT: Showing archived deals. Open a card to restore it.

DEAL_FORM.TITLE: New deal
DEAL_FORM.CONTACT_SEARCH: Search by name, email or phone

PIPELINES.DESCRIPTION: A pipeline is a funnel: it holds its own stages, its own deals and the rules that govern them.
PIPELINES.NAME: Name
PIPELINES.IS_DEFAULT_HINT: The one the board opens on. Only one pipeline can be the default, so turning this on takes it away from the current one.
PIPELINES.INGESTION_HINT: Pick the inboxes whose conversations should become cards in this funnel.
PIPELINES.INGESTION_ON_WARNING: Every new conversation in the selected inboxes will create a card in this funnel (one card per contact within the deduplication window). Only turn this on for inboxes whose conversations really are opportunities.
PIPELINES.INGESTION_OFF_HINT: No inbox selected: this funnel never creates cards on its own. Cards are only added by hand from the board.
PIPELINES.DEDUPE_DAYS_HINT: A contact who already has an open card created within this window gets the new conversation linked to that card instead of a second one.
PIPELINES.REQUIRES_NEXT_ACTIVITY_HINT: Flags open deals with no scheduled task.
PIPELINES.RESTRICTED_BY_OWNER_HINT: Agents only see their own deals and the ones with no owner. Administrators keep seeing everything.
PIPELINES.DELETE_MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete
PIPELINES.ARCHIVE_MESSAGE: It leaves the board and stops receiving new conversations, but every deal in it is kept. Archive
PIPELINES.UNARCHIVE_MESSAGE: It goes back to the board with its deals exactly as they were. Restore
PIPELINES.ARCHIVE_ERROR: Could not change the pipeline status

STAGES.DESCRIPTION: The columns of the board, in the order the deals travel through them. Drag to reorder.
STAGES.EMPTY: This pipeline has no stages yet
STAGES.NAME: Name
STAGES.CATEGORY_HINT: Moving a card into a won or lost stage closes the deal.
STAGES.ROTTING_DAYS_HINT: The card is flagged once it sits here without activity for this long.
STAGES.WIP_LIMIT_HINT: The board refuses a move into a column that is already full.
STAGES.IS_ENTRY_HINT: Where a new card lands when no stage is given.
STAGES.REORDER_ERROR: Could not save the new order
STAGES.DELETE_MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete

SOURCES.DESCRIPTION: Where the deals come from. A source is never deleted: turning it off keeps it on the deals that already carry it and removes it from the pickers.
SOURCES.NAME: Name
SOURCES.INBOX_HINT: The inbox this source stands for. Deals ingested from that inbox are tagged with it.
SOURCES.IDENTIFIER_HINT: Unique key used by integrations to reference this source.
SOURCES.ACTIVE_HINT: An inactive source stays on the deals that carry it but stops being offered.
SOURCES.INBOX_EXTERNAL_HINT: Where the contacts this source creates are registered. Required for a landing page, an API client or an n8n flow to send leads.

TOKEN.TITLE: External ingestion token
TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: The credential a landing page or an n8n flow uses to post leads into this funnel.
TOKEN.SHOWN_ONCE: Copy it now: this is the only time the token is shown. We only store a fingerprint of it, so it can never be read again — only replaced.
TOKEN.EMPTY_HINT: This source has no token yet. Generate one to let an external system send leads into the funnel.
TOKEN.EXISTING_HINT: This source already has a token. Generating a new one invalidates the current one immediately, and every integration using it stops working until it is updated.
TOKEN.INBOX_REQUIRED: Link an inbox to this source before using the token: the contact of each lead is registered in it.
TOKEN.USAGE_HINT: Either an email or a phone number is required. Title, value and utm are optional. A contact who already has an open deal within the deduplication window updates that deal instead of opening a second one.

LOST_REASONS.DESCRIPTION: The answers offered when a deal is marked as lost. A retired reason stays on the deals that carry it and leaves the picker.
LOST_REASONS.NAME: Name
LOST_REASONS.POSITION_HINT: Order the reasons appear in, lowest first.
LOST_REASONS.ACTIVE_HINT: An inactive reason cannot be picked when closing a deal.
LOST_REASONS.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the lost reason

DEAL.NO_CONVERSATIONS: No conversations linked to this deal
DEAL.NEXT_ACTIVITY_HINT: Schedule a task so this deal keeps moving
DEAL.UPDATE_CONFLICT: Another user edited this deal. Your changes were discarded and the card now shows their version.

MOVE.CONFLICT: This card has been updated by another user. Please refresh the list.
MOVE.WIP_EXCEEDED: Cannot move deal: column limit exceeded
MOVE.LOST_REASON_INACTIVE: That lost reason is no longer available. Pick another one.
MOVE.GENERIC_ERROR: An error occurred while moving the deal
